name: BrewPage
description: Free hosting for HTML pages, Markdown, JSON, key-value data and files: publish and get a shareable HTTPS link back, no account or API key; an owner token updates or deletes, content expires (up to 30 days). Endpoint: `https://brewpage.app/mcp` · Install: `npx -y brewpage-mcp` · [Docs](https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/) · Registry: `io.github.kochetkov-ma/brewpage-mcp`
